language.title: Language
language.interfaceHint: anything not yet translated shows in English
language.systemNotReady: system is set to {name} — not translated yet, so English is shown

coverage.title: Translation coverage
coverage.sub: counted from the bundled message files
coverage.contributeHint: Translations live in deliverer/src/locales — one folder per language, one JSON file per page. A language switches on once its coverage is real.

formats.title: Formats
formats.regionHint: Drives number separators and regional-style dates and times.

status.savedNextJob: saved · applies to the next job

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.local: your login stays on this computer
accounts.intro: Curio browses pixiv and X as you, the way your browser does. Signing in happens on the site's own page — Curio never sees your password. pixiv is required for finding artworks; X is optional and adds the artists' own posts.
accounts.skipped: You skipped this at first launch; signing in here does the same thing.

theme.title: Theme
theme.backgroundHint: Neutrals stay hue-locked to this colour; artwork tiles are never tinted.
theme.plateBlurHint: Blur only matters when opacity < 100%; it costs GPU on large galleries.
theme.cutCornersHint: square by default; polygonal plates when on

storage.title: Storage
storage.hint: The database never lives inside the library folder — moving the library to a synced drive is safe; the db is not.

network.title: Network
network.resolverDoh: doh — DNS over HTTPS (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8 by IP)
network.resolverHint: Layer 1 of the bypass: names resolve over HTTPS to an IP endpoint, so ISP DNS hijack is skipped. TLS still verifies the real hostname.
network.proxyHint: Layer 2, for SNI/DPI blocks. Also passed to gallery-dl. Certificate verification is never disabled — a proxy that needs that is an interceptor.
network.rateHint: Conservative on purpose — this is a private archive, not a mirror.
network.xSearchOff: off — X never searches, only follows linked artists
network.xSearchHint: For crawls started from the command line. Crawls from the app search until each character's “Posts per run”. Search is the request X rate-limits and suspends for. 0 turns X search off everywhere.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.hint: Exact sha256 always dedupes. Near-duplicates compare within the same artist only — cross-artist matches are far more often two people drawing the same pose than one repost. 6 is conservative; above 10 starts merging variants.

about.title: About
about.name: Curio
about.blurb: A private archive. Attribution is kept on every record; nothing here is meant to be redistributed.

characters.title: New characters
characters.lead: What a new character's form starts with. Each character can change it in its own form.
characters.identify: Name the character in every image
characters.identifyHint: Two taggers name who is in each kept image — any anime, game, manga or novel character they know. Unsure pictures are marked unidentified; nothing is removed. The first run downloads up to ~1.3 GB.
